sources.finding: Only extends NowAssistBaseResponse and delegates getResponseType to NowAssistSearchResponseHelper.getResponseType(this.getPayload()). No readiness signal in this class.

sources.name: NowAssistBaseResponse
sources.finding: getSummary produces type, message, citation_sources, search_results, and optionally raw_response. No readiness method or flag.

interpretation: For LLM conversations, _processTakeControl and _processScore both return before reading their enable properties. Missing takeControl/score is expected even with the properties true.
TopicFinished is stripped from the outbound body. It gates completed/faulted conversation flags in _updateResponseFromConversationState; it is not exposed as a user-turn readiness control.
setStreamingResponse uses a saved stream ID and inactive stream to emit END. It does not inspect pending tool execution or waiting-for-user state.
The output extension point can transform {inputPayload,responsePayload}; no safe internal waiting-for-user field has yet been proven. An extension should not invent readiness from END.
Small-talk response type exists upstream, but the observed Bot callback only has OutputText, and no proven stable small-talk type reaches that callback.

topicSearches.limit: Name searches do not prove that no indirect or differently named association exists.

callbackCounterexample.sameEndStructure: streamState END, streamActive false, no completed or takeControl, body OutputText with group/maskType/messageId/streamId/uiType/value
callbackCounterexample.conclusion: The same END structure can be followed 1.107 seconds later by continuing agent progress and 36.98 seconds later by actual InputText. END-only, streamId-based, and fixed quiet-time readiness are not proven safe barriers.

authoritativePolicy: Keep explicit supported input controls authoritative for accepting the next user turn; completed remains conversation termination. No source-proven replacement found for generic LLM replies.
